svg.title: Pulse — system architecture
svg.desc: GitHub CI publishes tested images to ECR. A manually triggered deployment authenticates using OIDC and invokes a bounded SSM document on one EC2 server. Caddy routes HTTPS requests to Flask; the web and scheduler containers share SQLite. Daily systemd backups upload SQLite snapshots to private S3. Terraform uses a separate versioned S3 backend with locking.
svg.text: Website monitoring · controlled delivery · persistent data
Solid: execution / data · Dashed: artifact selection / pull
One Linux host · Docker Compose network · eu-north-1
Source: live checks.db · Backup does not replace live data
Verified: download from S3 + isolated restore + app read checks
Existing EC2 and security group were created outside Terraform.
DELIVERY: automatic execution, manual trigger · Backups and state remain private · No automatic rollback
